text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Non-stop! This love of mine won't let
up. ♪
Leaving it at unrequited's not
enough. ☆

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Wow, both your singing and
choreography are
perfection! I can't wait
to see you on stage!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Light Hello is a producer with a number
of
concerts and projects under her belt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She is holding a fan event for retired top
idols,
and Smart Falcon is making an
appearance as a
guest performer.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I was right to invite you. Now all that's
left is to
get on stage and sing with that
"love" in your
voice!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I will! To think I'll be on the same stage as her... I still feel like I'm dreaming. I'm going to put all my emotions into my performance!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
This song is all about love, so I'm going
to cram
as much of it as I can into my
singing!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...I don't know if I'll be able to get my
emotions
across.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because it's more than just love! I have
so many
more emotions I want her to
feel!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Um, Hello? Would it be
okay if I
came up with my own lyrics? I
want to convey my
feelings with my own
words!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
You want to change the lyrics? There
isn't much
time until the event though...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I promise you it won't be half-hearted!
As an
Umadol, I'll deliver the perfect
performance!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...I see. I'll trust you. I'll also let the other
sections
know so we can make
adjustments to ensure the
best show
possible!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the event arrives, and it's
Smart
Falcon's turn to perform...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hello, I'm Smart Falcon! Ahem! I'm really
happy to
meet you! I've admired you for
a looong time!

text_block_list.name: Former Top Idol
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thank you! I'm really glad to see I
have cute
supporters like you!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I have something I, um... want to say! I've
put my
feelings into this song! Please
listen!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Your smile, it never dulls. ♪
Even now I
feel its pull. ♪

text_block_list.name: Former Top Idol
text_block_list.text:
Wow, this is my song! ...Huh? But, the
lyrics are
different?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
(This was the last song of the last
concert in your
tour. Your performance
exuded energy, even
though you had to
have been exhausted... I was

captivated.)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
(You were smiling even during your
retirement
concert. You made it your
mission to put smiles
on your fans' faces
until the very end!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
(No matter what, you always make sure
your fans
have a good time. And that's
why you're the top
idol I admire most!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The words "thank you" don't even begin
to
describe. ♪ The way you keep on
shining in my
eyes. ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Non-stop! I'll pass you on my way up. ♪
Leaving it
at admiration's not enough. ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
(I... I'll be an even greater top idol than
you!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
(I won't just put smiles on people's faces!
I'll sing,
dance, and run... I'll bring
courage to my fans all
over the world!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon sings her heart out, while
her idol
watches intently with fists
clenched.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... Did my feelings... did they reach you?

text_block_list.name: Former Top Idol
text_block_list.text:
...Loud and clear. I felt your passion,
resonating in
my chest so intensely it
made me tremble.

text_block_list.name: Former Top Idol
text_block_list.text:
Can I ask you something? That outfit
looks a lot
like the one I wore for my
retirement concert.
Could it be...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I based it on yours. You were so
dazzling
up on stage... I wanted so badly
to catch up with
you. Catch up... and
surpass you.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So I decided to make it more sparkly,
hoping that
one day, maybe I'll shine
just as bright!

text_block_list.name: Former Top Idol
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Don't forget that feeling. If
anyone can
make it to the top, it might
just be you.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I won't!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer and Hello! I was able
to say
everything I wanted to and get all
of my feelings
out.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Well, your passion certainly
rubbed off on
the crowd... and maybe
me as well.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I danced and sang with everything I
have. I put all
of who I am right now out
there!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But next time I stand in front of a crowd,
it'll be
as an even better version of
myself!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I want to inspire courage in all my fans,
just like
she spread smiles!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Confessing her resolve to her longtime
idol
appears to have strengthened Smart
Falcon's
drive to become a top Umadol.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll reach it, all right! I'm gonna be
a top
Umadol! ♪

text_block_list.name: Former Top Idol
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Let's go out on stage together! I
want to sing
with you!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wooow! Yes! That would be
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon gets to sing on stage with
the idol
she admires. I get the feeling
that it won't be long
until the day comes
when she herself is shining at
the top.
